name: ipo-tracker-app
description: A premium, responsive, mobile-first Web/PWA application built to track and analyze the listing and current performance of major Indian Mainboard IPOs over the past three years (May 2023 - May 2026).

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html style.css app.js chart.js ipo_data.json manifest.json sw.js www/ && cp -r icons www/
